Notes: Detects third-party actions referenced by mutable tags or branch names instead of full 40-char commit SHAs.
Detects explicit write-all permissions or missing permissions block defaulting to broad read/write scopes.
Detects pull_request_target trigger combined with explicit checkout of untrusted PR head reference.
Detects direct interpolation of untrusted GitHub event expressions into run: shell scripts.
Detects hardcoded high-entropy API tokens, private keys, or credentials embedded directly in YAML.
Detects commands that echo or dump secrets and environment variables to standard output/logs.
Detects static cloud access keys (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, GCP_SA_KEY) instead of OIDC federation.
Detects production deployment commands executing without an explicit GitHub Environment protection rule.
Detects self-hosted runners executing on public/untrusted pull request events.
Detects third-party actions from unverified publishers outside GitHub/Docker official namespaces.
Detects actions/checkout without persist-credentials: false leaving GitHub tokens on disk.
Detects sensitive repository secrets passed directly into an unpinned third-party action step.
Detects jobs referencing more than three distinct repository secrets.
Detects upload-artifact storing sensitive files (.env, id_rsa, credentials, keys).
Detects reusable workflow call passing secrets: inherit without fine-grained scoping.
Detects writing untrusted attacker input into GITHUB_ENV or GITHUB_PATH files.
Detects privileged workflow_run trigger downloading artifacts from untrusted workflow execution.
Detects issue_comment workflows executing commands without verifying commenter membership/privilege.
Detects workflow_dispatch inputs evaluated directly inside run: shell scripts.
Detects spoofable bot actor checks (e.g. github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]') without trigger checks.
Detects external reusable workflow called with mutable branch or tag instead of immutable commit SHA.
Detects container action or job container using mutable Docker tag (e.g. :latest) without SHA256 digest.
Detects downloading and executing remote scripts in a single command (curl | bash).
Detects ACTIONS_ALLOW_UNSECURE_COMMANDS environment variable enabling legacy set-env commands.
Detects actions/cache saving cache keys with untrusted user expressions or PR refs.
Detects id-token: write permission granted on untrusted fork triggers (pull_request_target).
Detects job requesting more than four distinct write permission scopes.
Detects continue-on-error: true set on security scanning, linting, or verification steps.
Detects jobs without timeout-minutes configured, exposing runners to 6-hour execution hang attacks.
Detects usage of action versions with known published GitHub Security Advisories.
